question.question: What happens after Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib, when and for whose hand, and must Sinbad win first?

fixed_key.expected_answer: After combat draw 1 into own hand, mandatory without win requirement if duel continues
required_facts: After combat draw 1 into own hand, mandatory without win requirement if duel continues

frozen_scope.asked_clauses: What happens after Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib, when and for whose hand, and must Sinbad win first?
required_answer_facts: After combat draw 1 into own hand, mandatory without win requirement if duel continues

clauses: What is drawn, timing, and whose hand receives it.
a.answer: After combat, draw 1 card into your hand (Sinbad’s hand). No combat win is required.

evidence.text: All **7 Voyage** cards are **Sinbad-only A/2, one copy each**. **Voyage Home has B1; the other six have no printed BOOST value.** Each has: **during combat, +1 value for each other Voyage card in your discard pile**. Their separate after-combat effects are below; they **do not require winning** unless an effect explicitly says so.
| Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib | Draw 1 card. |

clauses: Effect, timing and whose hand draws
Whether a combat win is required
b.answer: After combat, draw 1 card into Sinbad’s hand. A win is not required.

evidence.text:
| Voyage to the Cannibals with the Root of Madness | You **may move Sinbad up to 2 spaces**. |
| Voyage to the City of the Man-Eating Apes | Deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter. |
| Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib | Draw 1 card. |

question.question: Sinbad begins a maneuver with no Voyages in his discard pile, draws normally, then discards Voyage Home to BOOST before moving. What is the movement allowance for Sinbad and Porter in this maneuver, and does that discard resolve Home’s after-combat retrieval effect?

fixed_key.expected_answer: After discard Home is in discard pile: move2 + printed BOOST1 + Voyage-count1 =4 for each fighter; Discarding to BOOST ignores Home card effects so no after-combat retrieval
required_facts: After discard Home is in discard pile: move2 + printed BOOST1 + Voyage-count1 =4 for each fighter
Discarding to BOOST ignores Home card effects so no after-combat retrieval

frozen_scope.asked_clauses: Sinbad begins a maneuver with no Voyages in his discard pile, draws normally, then discards Voyage Home to BOOST before moving. What is the movement allowance for Sinbad and Porter in this maneuver, and does that discard resolve Home’s after-combat retrieval effect?
required_answer_facts: After discard Home is in discard pile: move2 + printed BOOST1 + Voyage-count1 =4 for each fighter
Discarding to BOOST ignores Home card effects so no after-combat retrieval

clauses: Movement allowance for Sinbad and Porter after draw and discarding Home to BOOST.
Whether Home’s after-combat retrieval effect resolves when discarded to BOOST.
a.answer: With Voyage Home discarded, its BOOST 1 adds to normal move 2; it also counts as one Voyage in the discard for Sinbad’s +1 maneuver bonus. Both Sinbad and Porter may move up to 4. Home’s after-combat retrieval effect does not resolve: it was discarded to BOOST, whose effects are ignored.

evidence.text:
1. **Draw 1 card first, mandatory.**
2. **Optionally move** each of your fighters, one at a time, up to your move value (plus applicable bonuses). Each fighter chooses its own distance, including **zero**. Choose their order, but finish one fighter’s movement before starting another’s.

**BOOST movement:** during a maneuver, discard **1 card from your hand** to add its printed **BOOST value** (the small circled number, not its combat value) to the movement value for this maneuver. Each of your fighters receives that allowance. Ignore the discarded card’s effects. A card that cannot be played because its fighter is defeated **can still be discarded to BOOST**. Effects may separately permit boosting attacks; boosting is not otherwise a universal option.

**Sinbad:** when you maneuver, each of your fighters may move **+1 space for each VOYAGE card in your discard pile**, added to the normal move value 2 and any maneuver BOOST. The bonus also applies to Porter. Count the Voyages actually in the discard pile when moving: if Voyage Home is discarded to BOOST this maneuver, it already counts there, in addition to its printed BOOST 1. A Voyage’s own combat value is its **printed 2 plus 1 per other Voyage in the discard pile during combat**, before any other modifiers. Resolve this bonus during combat before calculating damage. The card currently being played is not yet in that pile; played cards enter it only at the end of combat. Voyage Home can remove the accumulated cards from the pile, reducing later bonuses.

clauses: Voyage Home movement allowance after discard for this maneuver
Whether boosting with Home triggers its after-combat effect
b.answer: Discarding Voyage Home to BOOST adds its printed BOOST 1 to this maneuver, and because it is already in the discard pile, both Sinbad and Porter have allowance 3 (2+1). Its after-combat retrieval does not happen; it was discarded for BOOST, not played.
